subject: Purchase reference claim and line-item rationalization for Novaworks onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novaworks.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Novaworks Billing <billing@novaworks.io>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discrepancy on purchase reference for onboarding invoice

Hi Markus,

Quick note — we received a hold from our finance team: the invoice we submitted on 2027-06-01 (attached) doesn't appear to match the Purchase Reference you provided during onboarding. The invoice references 3 line items for integration services (SW-INTG-01, SW-INTG-02, SW-ONB-01) but the PR in your portal is blank and our payment is being queued. Can you confirm the PR that will be applied and whether the line items need to be remapped?

We also attached the onboarding packet (W9 + vendor form) in case something didn't process on your side. We need payment to avoid vendor service interruptions next week.

Attachments: invoice_20270601.pdf (pdf), vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (xlsx), signed_w9.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Accounting Lead, Novaworks Inc.
elena.ruiz@novaworks.io
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novaworks.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on purchase reference for onboarding invoice

Hi Elena — thanks for flagging this and for sending the docs. I pulled the onboarding record and see the vendor form landed but the Purchase Reference assignment failed during PO minting. Monica — can you confirm whether we have a provisional PR for Novaworks and whether a temporary spend cap was applied? Logan — tagging you for ledger reconciliation once the PR is issued.

Elena — to speed this up can you confirm the bank remit name and the preferred billing contact (if different from yourself)? If you can re-upload the vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx to the procurement portal that will trigger the automated PR flow; I'll escalate in the meantime.

Next steps (quick):
- Novaworks: confirm remit name & re-upload onboarding form to portal
- Procurement (Monica): check provisional PR status and request spend-cap release if needed
- Ledger (Logan): prepare to apply PR to invoice once issued

I'll follow up within two hours after Monica's check.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Supplier Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novaworks.io>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on purchase reference for onboarding invoice

Markus / Elena — I checked the onboarding queue. The vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx was received but the PO mint job failed due to a missing tax classification flag. I've created a temporary procurement ticket (PROC-1289) and requested an expedited provisional PR issuance.

I've also submitted a spend-cap override request so finance can clear the invoice while we finalize the PR. That request includes an escrow hold to protect Redwood spend bands; finance has 24 hours to approve.

Elena — when you re-upload, please set the tax classification field to "US-Service" (we observed a blank value on the file we received). If you prefer, I can apply the correction on your behalf with a signed confirmation.

Internal notes: once PR is minted we'll run a line-item rationalization to map SW-INTG-01/02 and SW-ONB-01 to our internal SKU taxonomy and produce a lineitem_fix_log.csv for the ledger team.

Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-1289
Estimated timeline: PR issuance within 6 business hours after corrected form or sooner if finance approves spend-cap override.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novaworks.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Novaworks Billing <billing@novaworks.io>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on purchase reference for onboarding invoice

Hi Monica / Markus — thanks, I re-uploaded the corrected onboarding form to the procurement portal and set tax classification to US-Service. I've also attached a brief cover note confirming the bank remit and billing contact.

Attached: signed_w9.pdf (pdf) — original; vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (re-uploaded via portal)

We would appreciate the provisional PR so our finance team can release payment. Please let me know if you need any additional signatures or documents.

Best,
Elena
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novaworks.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Procurement Ops <procurement@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: PR issued: PR-45289 and applied line-item mapping

Elena — good news: procurement issued Purchase Reference PR-45289 and I've attached the PDF copy. Monica completed the line-item rationalization and the ledger team (Logan) applied the mapping to invoice_20270601.pdf. The lineitem_fix_log.csv shows the remap:
- SW-INTG-01 -> INTG-SVC-1001
- SW-INTG-02 -> INTG-SVC-1002
- SW-ONB-01 -> ONB-SVC-2001

Finance approved a one-time spend-cap release under escrow (see PROC-1289) so payment can proceed. Logan, please confirm when the general ledger entries are posted and when Novaworks should expect funds to clear.

Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-1289, https://docusign.net/ABC12345-PR-45289

Attachments: po_PR-45289.pdf (pdf), lineitem_fix_log.csv (csv)

Thanks everyone — marking this thread as resolved on my side.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Supplier Ops, Redwood Inference
